thread.title: All 30 Dow stocks fall, led by Caterpillar and Boeing - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: All 30 Dow stocks fall, led by Caterpillar and Boeing - MarketWatch
text: Shares of all 30 Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +0.04% components fell in premarket trade Wednesday, led by selloffs in Caterpillar Inc.'s CAT, +1.74% and Boeing Co.'s BA, -1.09% stocks, as the resignation of Gary Cohn cast a pall on the broader market . Dow futures YMH8, -1.05% slumped 268 points. Shares of Caterpillar shed 2.2%, and were on track to shave about 24 points off the Dow's price, while Boeing's stock lost 1.8% to put it on track to shave about 44 points off the Dow. The most-active stocks were Apple Inc. AAPL, -0.08% which shed 0.9%, and Intel Corp.'s INTC, +1.93% which lost 1.1%. The best performer was Coca-Cola Co. shares KO, +0.09% which were down just 0.6%.
